summary: Completed testing of 7 findings from operational roleplay. All backend tests passed (9/9). Frontend UI verified: Sync button shows correct toast, Intentos column visible, cleanup confirmation dialog works, Layout page has correct date picker label.

minor.issue: Existing packages created before composite key fix don't have cosmo_route_id field - only new packages will have it

Fix_1_Sync_Button_Toast.details: POST /api/sync/tracking returns {status: 'started'}. Dashboard shows 'Sincronización iniciada en segundo plano' toast (NOT 'undefined verificados'). Verified via UI screenshot.

Fix_2_Evidence_Re_Evaluation.details: Backend code at kosmo_sync.py lines 260-264 evaluates ALL scraped packages post-sync. Delivered packages have evidence_score and evidence_type fields populated.

Fix_3_Cleanup_Confirmation_Dialog.details: Settings page 'Limpiar rutas y pedidos' button shows AlertDialog confirmation with title '¿Eliminar todas las rutas y paquetes?' and 'Sí, eliminar todo' / 'Cancelar' buttons before executing cleanup.

Fix_4_Close_Form_Text.details: JourneyDetail.jsx line 1703 has correct text: 'paquete(s) Fallido(s) marcado(s) para devolución'. Text appears when failed packages are selected for return.

Fix_5_Composite_Key_Deduplication.details: Backend server.py lines 1083-1094 uses composite key (cosmo_route_id + order_reference_id) for package deduplication. New packages include cosmo_route_id field (line 1263). Journeys have cosmo_route_id field.

Fix_6_Delivery_Attempts_Column.details: Journey detail API enriches packages with delivery_attempt field via aggregation pipeline (lines 573-585). Frontend shows 'INTENTOS' column between EVIDENCIAS and REVISADO columns. All current packages show '1' as no duplicate order_reference_ids exist across routes yet.

Fix_7_Creation_Date_Usage.details: Route-summary parser extracts creation_date field (line 980). Journey creation uses route's creation_date as journey date when available (lines 1221-1226). Layout page date picker label says 'Fecha de las rutas (respaldo)' with helper text about Creation Date (lines 549, 570).

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing journeys and packages.

database_notes.existing_packages: Packages created before composite key fix don't have cosmo_route_id field
database_notes.delivery_attempt: All packages show delivery_attempt=1 since no duplicate order_reference_ids exist across routes yet

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 tested 7 findings from operational roleplay. All features verified working: (1) Sync button toast shows correct message, (2) Evidence re-evaluation for all scraped packages, (3) Cleanup confirmation dialog, (4) Close form text for failed packages, (5) Composite key deduplication, (6) Delivery attempts column, (7) Creation Date usage. Note: Layout page requires agent/coordinator role (not developer). The delivery_attempt field will show values > 1 only when same order_reference_id appears in multiple routes.
